## Runs 6 & 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0, T ≈ 1.2–1.3 K

Both spot checks complete and clean, no clipping (max R 576 Ω on a 5 kΩ FS), no leakage trips. Raw first, then the windowed FFT (1/B) with the `tetralayer_fs_count` model overlays and the `sdh_onset` per-tone table.

**Read — electron side (run 6, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T):** strong SdH from ≲ 2 T; tone set {**7.11**, 14.08, **22.08**, 29.47} T. 14.08 = 2×7.11 (clean 2nd harmonic). The record's δF ≈ 1.1 T leaves the classification genuinely forked: **(a) ABAB pair** {7.1, 22.1} summing to 29.2 T = 0.88·F_L (inside the lever-arm prior), partition 0.24/0.76 (model: 0.22/0.78 at this n), with 29.47 T the symmetry-allowed breakdown/sum tone at the same scaled F_L — vs **(b) harmonic comb** of a lone ~7.1–7.4 T pocket (3f = 21.3, 4f = 28.4; both within ~δF of the observed 22.1, 29.5). Against (b): a lone 7 T pocket carries only 0.22·F_L — a gross Luttinger violation unless partnered, and 22.08/7.11 = 3.11 ≠ 3.000 (though within single-record precision). This is exactly the "ratio drifts through 3×" trap (investigation, Why): **the discriminator is n-dependence** — a harmonic tracks 3·f_light(n) identically; the model's heavy/light ratio drifts 6.1 → 3.5 across n = 1.6 → 3.2×10¹². The slow structure above 7.5 T (R → 520 Ω) is the light pocket approaching its quantum limit (ν_light ≈ 4·7.1/B ≈ 3.6 at 8 T) — not a defect. **Onset:** carrying tone censored at the clean-leg edge, B = 1.0 T (the 0–1 T leg is 50 mT coarse — aliased for a 7 T tone; sub-1 T "tracking" there is not trustworthy) → onset ≤ 1.0 T, pinned by the low-field extension (next measure cell).

**Read — hole side (run 7, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T):** the expected near-CNP exception regime — close, balanced tones {4.72, 6.59} T summing to 11.3 T = 0.91·F_L, plus their harmonics (9.38 ≈ 2×4.72, 14.83 ≈ 3.1×4.72, 26.2 ≈ 4×6.6) and beat-like raw structure. Onset 0.71 T. Consistent with the electron-side story at the **same global scale ≈ 0.88–0.91** (the Verify's single in-band rescale — coherent across both signs), but not independently classifying: at this |n| the templates don't separate at any practical δF.

**Verdict for Step 4:** both sides show a two-tone-consistent set at a shared scale ≈ 0.9 — ABAB-leaning, unproven (harmonic fork open, F_L-tone origin untested). **Electron side is decisively cleaner → the Landau fan goes there**, n = 1.6 → 3.2×10¹² at D = 0, deciding the fork by per-column F(n) trajectories. Locked from these runs and handed to the fan: sensitivity 50 µV (worst corner bracketed by run 7's 576 Ω max), τ = 0.3 s settling, Δ(1/B) = 0.01 (run 6's fine-leg spacing at its binding low edge). Mosaic caveat from run 5: region B (+0.43×10¹² relative doping) can add tones at ×~1.1–1.3 shifted density — read per the same F_L, don't force onto one template.

"""sdh-spot-check runs 6 (electron n=+3.2e12) & 7 (hole n=-1.2e12), D = 0: raw R(B), windowed
FFT in 1/B, per-tone onsets (hera.analysis.sdh_onset). Model overlays: tetralayer_fs_count."""
import sys
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

I_BIAS = 1.0 / 100e6                     # 1 V drive / 100 MOhm
R_FS = 50e-6 / I_BIAS                    # sr1 sens 50 uV -> 5 kOhm full scale
cases = {                                # model pair from fs_count_b0.abab_fs (SI m^-2 input)
    6: dict(n=+3.2e16, brange=(1.0, 10.0), model=dict(light=7.31, heavy=25.78),
            label="run 6 — electron n=+3.2e12, B 0→10 T (10 mT ≥1 T; 50 mT below = aliased for F ≥ 4 T)"),
    7: dict(n=-1.2e16, brange=(0.72, 10.0), model=dict(light=1.15, heavy=11.25),
            label="run 7 — hole n=−1.2e12, B 10→0.3 T (20 mT)"),
}

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for i, (rid, c) in enumerate(cases.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    assert not r.interrupted
    B, R = r.col("magnet_field"), r.col("sr1_X") / I_BIAS   # sr1 gain 1
    o = np.argsort(B)
    B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(c["n"]))

    ax = axs[0, i]                                          # raw first
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6, color="k")
    ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel=r"Rxx ($\Omega$)", title=c["label"], xlim=(0, 10.2))

    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=c["brange"], log=False)
    s = spec[0] / spec[0][freqs > 2].max()
    ax2 = axs[1, i]
    ax2.plot(freqs, s, lw=0.9, color="k")
    ax2.axvline(FL, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    ax2.axvline(c["model"]["light"], color="tab:blue", ls=":", lw=1, label=f"model ABAB light {c['model']['light']:.1f} T")
    ax2.axvline(c["model"]["heavy"], color="tab:green", ls=":", lw=1, label=f"model ABAB heavy {c['model']['heavy']:.1f} T")
    ax2.set(xlabel="F (T)", xlim=(0, 1.4 * FL), ylim=(0, 1.1), ylabel="FFT mag (norm)",
            title=f"run {rid} FFT, B ∈ {c['brange']} T; δF = {1/(1/c['brange'][0]-1/c['brange'][1]):.2f} T")
    ax2.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")

    print(f"===== {c['label']} =====   F_L = {FL:.1f} T; R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (FS {R_FS:.0f})")
    ons = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=R_FS)
    print(f"sdh_onset: onset_b = {ons.onset_b:.2f} T (carrying tone censored: {ons.tones[0].censored})")
    for t in sorted(ons.tones, key=lambda t: -t.contrast)[:6]:
        print(f"  tone F = {t.freq:6.2f} T ({t.freq/FL:.3f} F_L)  contrast {t.contrast:6.1f}  onset {t.onset_b:.2f} T"
              f"{'  CENSORED' if t.censored else ''}{f'  flagged harmonic_of {t.harmonic_of:.2f}' if t.harmonic_of else ''}")
    pk, _ = find_peaks(s, height=0.08, distance=4)
    print("  windowed-FFT peaks:", ", ".join(f"{freqs[p]:.2f} T ({freqs[p]/FL:.2f} F_L)" for p in pk if freqs[p] > 1.5))

fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## HERA — Step 3c: low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹², B 0.3 → 1.0 T

> **05:29** · sdh-spot-check low-B extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0 electron spot, B 0.3->1.0 T uniform 1/B (118 pts, d(1/B)=0.02), sr1 50 uV; pins run 6 censored onset; ends at fan B\_lo=1.0 T · **ETA ~05:49** (≈20 min)

Run 6's carrying tone (7.11 T) is **censored** at B = 1.0 T — the 0–1 T leg was 50 mT coarse (MR-background sizing), which aliases a 7 T tone, so the true onset is only bounded (≤ 1.0 T). `landau-fan` step 1 lever (1): a censored onset gets a cheap low-field extension **before** committing the fan. This run pins it: same spot (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0, run-5 cal), 0.3 → 1.0 T uniform 1/B, Δ(1/B) = 0.02 (Nyquist to 25 T — the carrying tone + its 2nd harmonic; the heavier tones onset above 1.3 T and aren't the target). It **ends at 1.0 T = the fan's B_lo**, so ~5 of its ~14 min are fan positioning we'd pay anyway. Decision rule on its read: fan design below holds at B_lo = 1.0 T; only a strong onset well below 0.7 T re-opens the B_lo choice (priced: B_lo = 0.7 costs +~80 min for δF 1.11 → 0.75 T). Preconditions: B ≈ 0 (operator reset), T base, V_si = 0, nplci 1/1. Checkpoint: first ~20 pts (signal, leakage, T).

# === SdH low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.3 -> 1.0 T uniform 1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)  # run 5
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep enters at 0.3), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform 1/B, ascending 0.3 -> 1.0 T; d(1/B) = 0.02 (Nyquist ceiling 25 T: covers the
#     7.1 T carrying tone + its 14.2 T 2nd harmonic at the 1/3 rule; heavy/sum tones onset above 1.3 T).
B_vec = field_invB(0.3, 1.0, 118)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # 5 kOhm FS, as run 6; R(<1 T) ~ 20-70 Ohm
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T uniform 1/B; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check low-field extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), B 0.3 -> 1.0 T uniform 1/B, pins run 6's censored onset; ends at 1.0 T = fan B_lo"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension of run 6: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = 0; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.3 -> 1.0 T uniform 1/B (118 pts, d(1/B) = 0.02); sr1 50 uV; positions the magnet at the landau-fan B_lo')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot(magnet.field, T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# field stays at 1.0 T (the fan's B_lo); gates stay near the fan's n_max end — no park.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
